metadata.title: Will Tipra Motha Join Government in Tripura | Exclusive Interview | Main Bhi Bharat
metadata.description: BJP with it’s ally IPFT has got majority to form a new government in Tripura. But it has offered Tipra Motha to join the government if it leaves the demand of a separate Greater Tripraland. In an exclusive interview with Main Bhi Bharat, newly elected MLA and a senior leader of Tipra Motha has explained how Tipra Motha looks at this offer from BJP.
